name: Fugue Integration
run-name: "Fugue Integration PR #${{ inputs.pr }} ${{ inputs.request_id }} ${{ inputs.run_token }}"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: Pull request number to integrate
        required: true
        type: number
      request_id:
        description: Durable Fugue Integration request ID
        required: true
        type: string
      dispatch_secret:
        description: One-use protected dispatch capability
        required: true
        type: string
      authority_anchor:
        description: Exact immutable Fugue Authority request anchor
        required: true
        type: string
      run_token:
        description: Secret-derived one-run correlation token
        required: true
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: fugue-integration-${{ github.repository }}-${{ inputs.pr }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # SECURITY INVARIANT (external): configure the restrictive default-branch-only deployment
    # policy before installing the Authority App key. The in-job audit is drift detection only.
    environment: fugue-authority
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
      statuses: write
    outputs:
      head_sha: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.head_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Audit external Fugue Authority environment invariant
        env:
          FUGUE_PROTECTED_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          const [owner, repo] = process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY.split('/');
          const branch = process.env.FUGUE_PROTECTED_BRANCH;
          if (!branch) throw new Error('Repository default branch is unavailable.');
          const headers = {
            Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
            Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN}`,
            'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
          };
          const base = `https://api.github.com/repos/${owner}/${repo}/environments/fugue-authority`;
          const environmentResponse = await fetch(base, { headers });
          if (!environmentResponse.ok) {
            throw new Error(`fugue-authority environment is unavailable (${environmentResponse.status}); authority remains fail-closed.`);
          }
          const environment = await environmentResponse.json();
          const deployment = environment.deployment_branch_policy;
          if (!deployment || deployment.protected_branches !== false || deployment.custom_branch_policies !== true) {
            throw new Error('fugue-authority must use an explicit custom deployment branch policy.');
          }
          const policiesResponse = await fetch(`${base}/deployment-branch-policies?per_page=100`, { headers });
          if (!policiesResponse.ok) throw new Error(`Unable to verify fugue-authority branch policy (${policiesResponse.status}).`);
          const policies = await policiesResponse.json();
          const names = (policies.branch_policies ?? []).map((policy) => policy.name).sort();
          if (names.length !== 1 || names[0] !== branch) {
            throw new Error(`fugue-authority must allow exactly protected branch ${branch}; found ${names.join(', ') || 'none'}.`);
          }
          NODE
      - name: Mint narrow Fugue Authority token
        id: fugue-authority
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v3
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.FUGUE_AUTHORITY_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.FUGUE_AUTHORITY_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-variables: write
      - name: Commit protected Integration run-start evidence
        env:
          FUGUE_AUTHORITY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.fugue-authority.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import { createHash, createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
          import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

          const repository = process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY;
          const [owner, repo] = repository.split('/');
          const event = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_PATH, 'utf8'));
          const inputs = event.inputs ?? {};
          const requestId = String(inputs.request_id ?? '');
          const prNumber = Number(inputs.pr);
          const secret = String(inputs.dispatch_secret ?? '');
          const anchorName = String(inputs.authority_anchor ?? '');
          const runToken = String(inputs.run_token ?? '');
          const runId = Number(process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID);
          const runAttempt = Number(process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT);
          const baseSha = process.env.GITHUB_SHA;
          if (!/^int-[0-9a-f]{16}-[0-9a-f]{16}$/.test(requestId) || !Number.isInteger(prNumber) || prNumber <= 0 ||
              !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(secret) || !/^FUGUE_INT_A_\d{10}_[0-9A-F]{16}$/.test(anchorName) ||
              !/^[0-9a-f]{24}$/.test(runToken) || !Number.isInteger(runId) || runId <= 0 || runAttempt !== 1 ||
              !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i.test(baseSha)) {
            throw new Error('Invalid protected Integration dispatch context.');
          }
          process.stdout.write('::add-mask::' + secret + '\n');
          const digest = createHash('sha256').update(secret, 'utf8').digest('hex');
          const expectedRunToken = createHmac('sha256', Buffer.from(secret, 'hex'))
            .update(`fugue-integration-run\0${requestId}`, 'utf8').digest('hex').slice(0, 24);
          if (runToken !== expectedRunToken) throw new Error('Protected Integration run token does not match its one-use dispatch capability.');
          const requestToken = createHash('sha256').update(requestId, 'utf8').digest('hex').slice(0, 16).toUpperCase();
          const suffix = createHash('sha256').update(requestId, 'utf8').digest('hex').slice(0, 32).toUpperCase();
          const startName = `FUGUE_INT_S_${String(prNumber).padStart(10, '0')}_${requestToken}`;
          const fenceName = `FUGUE_INT_F_${suffix}`;
          const commitName = `FUGUE_INT_C_${suffix}`;
          const apiBase = `https://api.github.com/repos/${owner}/${repo}`;
          const headers = {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.FUGUE_AUTHORITY_TOKEN}`,
            Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
            'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          };
          async function request(path, init = {}) {
            return fetch(`${apiBase}${path}`, { ...init, headers: { ...headers, ...(init.headers ?? {}) } });
          }
          async function read(path, allow404 = false) {
            const response = await request(path);
            if (allow404 && response.status === 404) return null;
            const body = await response.text();
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Fugue Authority API ${response.status} for ${path}: ${body.slice(0, 300)}`);
            return body ? JSON.parse(body) : {};
          }
          async function createVariable(name, value) {
            const response = await request('/actions/variables', {
              method: 'POST',
              body: JSON.stringify({ name, value }),
            });
            if (response.status !== 201 && response.status !== 409 && response.status !== 422) {
              throw new Error(`Unable to create protected Integration variable ${name} (${response.status}).`);
            }
          }
          async function deleteVariable(name) {
            const response = await request(`/actions/variables/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
            if (response.status !== 204 && response.status !== 404) {
              throw new Error(`Unable to delete protected Integration variable ${name} (${response.status}).`);
            }
          }
          function parseBlock(body, marker) {
            const start = body.indexOf(marker);
            if (start < 0) return null;
            const end = body.indexOf('-->', start + marker.length);
            if (end < 0) throw new Error(`Unterminated ${marker} evidence.`);
            const block = body.slice(start + marker.length, end).trim();
            const match = block.match(/^version: 1\npayload: ([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)$/);
            if (!match) throw new Error(`Malformed ${marker} evidence.`);
            return JSON.parse(Buffer.from(match[1], 'base64url').toString('utf8'));
          }
          function evidenceBody(marker, value, label) {
            const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value), 'utf8').toString('base64url');
            return `${marker}\nversion: 1\npayload: ${payload}\n-->\n\n${label}`;
          }

          function stableSort(value) {
            if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(stableSort);
            if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
              return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([k, v]) => [k, stableSort(v)]));
            }
            return value;
          }
          function yamlScalar(raw) {
            const value = String(raw ?? '').trim();
            if (value === 'null') return null;
            if (value === 'true') return true;
            if (value === 'false') return false;
            if (/^-?\d+$/.test(value)) return Number(value);
            if (value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')) {
              try { return JSON.parse(value); } catch { return value.slice(1, -1); }
            }
            if (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'")) return value.slice(1, -1).replace(/''/g, "'");
            return value;
          }
          function yamlSection(yaml, key) {
            const lines = yaml.split('\n');
            const index = lines.findIndex((line) => line === `${key}:`);
            if (index < 0) return null;
            const result = [];
            for (let i = index + 1; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
              if (lines[i] && !lines[i].startsWith(' ')) break;
              result.push(lines[i]);
            }
            return result;
          }
          function yamlField(lines, key, indent = 2) {
            if (!lines) return undefined;
            const prefix = `${' '.repeat(indent)}${key}:`;
            const line = lines.find((candidate) => candidate.startsWith(prefix));
            if (!line) return undefined;
            return yamlScalar(line.slice(prefix.length));
          }
          function parseIntegrationRecordBody(body) {
            const start = body.indexOf('<!-- fugue-integration-record');
            if (start < 0) return null;
            const end = body.indexOf('-->', start);
            if (end < 0) return null;
            const yaml = body.slice(start + '<!-- fugue-integration-record'.length, end).trim();
            const identityLines = yamlSection(yaml, 'identity');
            const requestLines = yamlSection(yaml, 'request');
            const dispatchLines = yamlSection(yaml, 'dispatch');
            const runLines = yamlSection(yaml, 'run');
            if (!identityLines || !requestLines || !dispatchLines || !runLines) return null;
            const identityKeys = ['prNumber', 'headSha', 'baseBranch', 'baseSha', 'policyDigest', 'protocolVersion', 'issueNumber', 'workId', 'workSpecDigest'];
            const identity = Object.fromEntries(identityKeys.map((key) => [key, yamlField(identityLines, key, 2)]));
            const requestIdentity = Object.fromEntries(identityKeys.map((key) => [key, yamlField(requestLines, key, 4)]));
            return {
              identity,
              request: {
                request_id: yamlField(requestLines, 'request_id', 2),
                created_at: yamlField(requestLines, 'created_at', 2),
                identity: requestIdentity,
              },
              dispatch: { anchor_name: yamlField(dispatchLines, 'anchor_name', 2) },
              run: {
                id: yamlField(runLines, 'id', 2),
                attempt: yamlField(runLines, 'attempt', 2),
              },
              created_at: yamlScalar(yaml.split('\n').find((line) => line.startsWith('created_at:'))?.slice('created_at:'.length) ?? ''),
            };
          }
          async function durableExactBindingAfterCleanup() {
            const cursorBodies = [];
            for (let page = 1; page <= 5; page += 1) {
              const response = await read(`/actions/variables?per_page=100&page=${page}`);
              const variables = Array.isArray(response.variables) ? response.variables : [];
              for (const candidate of variables) {
                const name = String(candidate.name ?? '');
                const value = String(candidate.value ?? '');
                if (name.startsWith('FUGUE_D3_')) cursorBodies.push(value);
                if (name.startsWith('FUGUE_D3P_')) {
                  try {
                    const pack = JSON.parse(value);
                    if (pack?.kind === 'durable_recovery_pack' && Array.isArray(pack.entries)) {
                      for (const entry of pack.entries) if (typeof entry === 'string') cursorBodies.push(entry);
                    }
                  } catch { /* malformed protected pack is not fallback authority */ }
                }
              }
              if (variables.length < 100) break;
            }
            const matches = [];
            for (const cursorBody of cursorBodies) {
              if (!cursorBody.includes('<!-- fugue-publisher-proof')) continue;
              let cursor;
              try { cursor = parseBlock(cursorBody, '<!-- fugue-durable-recovery'); } catch { continue; }
              if (!cursor || cursor.version !== 1 || cursor.kind !== 'durable_recovery' || cursor.commit_witness !== true ||
                  cursor.scope !== `integration/${prNumber}` || cursor.publisher_sha?.toLowerCase() !== baseSha.toLowerCase() ||
                  typeof cursor.best_body_b64 !== 'string' || !cursor.best_manifest ||
                  !Array.isArray(cursor.best_manifest.status_ids) || cursor.best_manifest.status_ids.length !== cursor.best_manifest.chunk_count ||
                  typeof cursor.best_manifest.proof !== 'string' || !cursor.best_manifest.proof ||
                  typeof cursor.best_manifest.authority_order_b64 !== 'string') continue;
              let bestBody;
              let order;
              try {
                bestBody = Buffer.from(cursor.best_body_b64, 'base64url').toString('utf8');
                order = Buffer.from(cursor.best_manifest.authority_order_b64, 'base64url').toString('utf8');
              } catch { continue; }
              const record = parseIntegrationRecordBody(bestBody);
              if (!record?.run || record.request?.request_id !== requestId || record.identity?.prNumber !== prNumber ||
                  record.identity?.baseSha?.toLowerCase() !== baseSha.toLowerCase() || record.dispatch?.anchor_name !== anchorName ||
                  record.run.id !== runId || record.run.attempt !== runAttempt || record.created_at !== order ||
                  JSON.stringify(record.identity) !== JSON.stringify(record.request.identity)) continue;
              const nonce = requestId.match(/^int-[0-9a-f]{16}-([0-9a-f]{16})$/)?.[1];
              if (!nonce) continue;
              const canonicalDigest = createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(stableSort(record.identity)), 'utf8').digest('hex').slice(0, 16);
              const canonicalRequestId = `int-${canonicalDigest}-${nonce}`;
              const expectedAnchor = `FUGUE_INT_A_${String(prNumber).padStart(10, '0')}_${createHash('sha256').update(requestId, 'utf8').digest('hex').slice(0, 16).toUpperCase()}`;
              if (canonicalRequestId !== requestId || expectedAnchor !== anchorName || cursor.storage_sha?.toLowerCase() !== record.identity.headSha?.toLowerCase()) continue;
              matches.push({ order, body: bestBody });
            }
            if (!matches.length) return false;
            matches.sort((a, b) => a.order.localeCompare(b.order));
            const greatest = matches.at(-1);
            const conflicts = matches.filter((candidate) => candidate.order === greatest.order && candidate.body !== greatest.body);
            if (conflicts.length) throw new Error('Conflicting equal-order durable Integration authority cannot authorize cleanup-aware run-start no-op.');
            return true;
          }

          const variable = await read(`/actions/variables/${anchorName}`, true);
          if (!variable) {
            if (await durableExactBindingAfterCleanup()) process.exit(0);
            throw new Error('Protected Integration request anchor is missing without matching durable d3 exact-run authority.');
          }
          const anchor = parseBlock(String(variable.value ?? ''), '<!-- fugue-integration-dispatch-anchor');
          if (!anchor || anchor.kind !== 'integration_dispatch_anchor' || anchor.anchor_name !== anchorName ||
              anchor.request?.request_id !== requestId || anchor.request?.identity?.prNumber !== prNumber ||
              anchor.request?.identity?.baseSha !== baseSha || anchor.secret_digest !== digest ||
              anchor.dispatch_secret !== secret || !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i.test(anchor.request?.identity?.headSha ?? '')) {
            throw new Error('Workflow dispatch does not match its immutable protected Integration request anchor.');
          }

          const fenceVariable = await read(`/actions/variables/${fenceName}`, true);
          // S is a delayed exact-L writer. If durable exact binding or identity_lost already reclaimed F,
          // it must be inert and must not recreate authority for the old request.
          if (!fenceVariable) {
            if (await durableExactBindingAfterCleanup()) process.exit(0);
            throw new Error('Protected Integration dispatch fence is missing without matching durable d3 exact-run authority.');
          }
          let fence;
          try { fence = JSON.parse(String(fenceVariable.value ?? '')); }
          catch { throw new Error('Protected Integration dispatch fence is malformed.'); }
          if (fence?.version !== 1 || fence?.kind !== 'integration_dispatch_fence' ||
              fence.request_id !== requestId || fence.pr_number !== prNumber ||
              fence.head_sha?.toLowerCase() !== anchor.request.identity.headSha.toLowerCase() ||
              fence.base_sha?.toLowerCase() !== baseSha.toLowerCase() || fence.anchor_name !== anchorName ||
              fence.secret_digest?.toLowerCase() !== digest.toLowerCase() || fence.run_token !== runToken ||
              !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(String(fence.created_at ?? '')))) {
            throw new Error('Protected Integration run-start conflicts with its immutable dispatch fence.');
          }

          const existing = await read(`/actions/variables/${startName}`, true);
          if (existing) {
            const winner = parseBlock(String(existing.value ?? ''), '<!-- fugue-integration-run-start');
            if (winner?.run_id === runId && winner?.run_attempt === 1 && winner?.secret_digest === digest && winner?.anchor_name === anchorName) process.exit(0);
            throw new Error('Protected Integration dispatch capability was already consumed by another run.');
          }

          // C is the request-local first-writer-wins serialization point shared by B/S/d3 exact
          // binding and identity_lost. Claim it before publishing S; if identity_lost already won,
          // this delayed run-start is permanently inert.
          const candidateCreatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
          const htmlUrl = `https://github.com/${repository}/actions/runs/${runId}`;
          const exactCommit = {
            version: 1,
            kind: 'integration_exact_run_commit',
            request_id: requestId,
            pr_number: prNumber,
            head_sha: anchor.request.identity.headSha,
            base_sha: baseSha,
            anchor_name: anchorName,
            run_id: runId,
            run_attempt: 1,
            run_created_at: candidateCreatedAt,
            html_url: htmlUrl,
          };
          await createVariable(commitName, JSON.stringify(exactCommit));
          const commitVariable = await read(`/actions/variables/${commitName}`);
          let commit;
          try { commit = JSON.parse(String(commitVariable.value ?? '')); }
          catch { throw new Error('Protected Integration request-local commit is malformed.'); }
          if (commit?.kind === 'integration_identity_lost_commit') process.exit(0);
          if (commit?.version !== 1 || commit?.kind !== 'integration_exact_run_commit' ||
              commit.request_id !== requestId || commit.pr_number !== prNumber ||
              commit.head_sha?.toLowerCase() !== anchor.request.identity.headSha.toLowerCase() ||
              commit.base_sha?.toLowerCase() !== baseSha.toLowerCase() || commit.anchor_name !== anchorName ||
              commit.run_id !== runId || commit.run_attempt !== 1 || commit.html_url !== htmlUrl ||
              !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(String(commit.run_created_at ?? '')))) {
            throw new Error('Protected Integration request-local commit was already claimed by another run.');
          }

          // Cleanup deletes F/A before C. Re-read both after C so a run-start job that was already
          // executing cannot recreate C/S after terminal cleanup. Missing prerequisites make the
          // delayed writer inert and it self-reclaims its recreated C slot.
          const fenceAfterCommit = await read(`/actions/variables/${fenceName}`, true);
          const anchorAfterCommit = await read(`/actions/variables/${anchorName}`, true);
          if (!fenceAfterCommit || !anchorAfterCommit) {
            await deleteVariable(commitName);
            if (await durableExactBindingAfterCleanup()) process.exit(0);
            throw new Error('Protected Integration prerequisites disappeared without matching durable d3 exact-run authority.');
          }
          if (String(fenceAfterCommit.value ?? '') !== String(fenceVariable.value ?? '') ||
              String(anchorAfterCommit.value ?? '') !== String(variable.value ?? '')) {
            throw new Error('Protected Integration prerequisites changed across exact-run serialization.');
          }

          const createdAt = commit.run_created_at;
          const startEvidence = {
            version: 1,
            kind: 'integration_run_start',
            request_id: requestId,
            pr_number: prNumber,
            head_sha: anchor.request.identity.headSha,
            base_sha: baseSha,
            secret_digest: digest,
            anchor_name: anchorName,
            run_id: runId,
            run_attempt: 1,
            created_at: createdAt,
          };
          const canonical = evidenceBody('<!-- fugue-integration-run-start', startEvidence, 'INTEGRATION RUN — STARTED');
          const bodyDigest = createHash('sha256').update(canonical, 'utf8').digest('hex');
          const audience = `fugue:v1:${repository}:comment:${bodyDigest}`;
          const oidcUrl = new URL(process.env.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL);
          oidcUrl.searchParams.set('audience', audience);
          const oidcResponse = await fetch(oidcUrl, {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN}` },
          });
          if (!oidcResponse.ok) throw new Error(`Unable to mint protected Integration OIDC proof (${oidcResponse.status}).`);
          const oidc = await oidcResponse.json();
          if (typeof oidc.value !== 'string' || !oidc.value) throw new Error('GitHub OIDC response did not contain a token.');
          const signed = `${canonical}\n\n<!-- fugue-publisher-proof\nversion: 1\ntoken: ${oidc.value}\n-->`;
          await createVariable(startName, signed);
          const committed = await read(`/actions/variables/${startName}`);
          if (committed.value !== signed) {
            const winner = parseBlock(String(committed.value ?? ''), '<!-- fugue-integration-run-start');
            if (winner?.run_id !== runId || winner?.run_attempt !== 1 || winner?.secret_digest !== digest || winner?.anchor_name !== anchorName) {
              throw new Error('Protected Integration dispatch capability was consumed by another attempt-1 run.');
            }
          }
          NODE
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - id: prepare
        name: Prepare immutable Integration plan
        env:
          FUGUE_PR: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          FUGUE_REQUEST_ID: ${{ inputs.request_id }}
          FUGUE_RUNTIME_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          FUGUE_AUTHORITY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.fugue-authority.outputs.token }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: >-
          node dist/cli.js integration-runtime prepare "$FUGUE_PR"
          --request-id "$FUGUE_REQUEST_ID"
          --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/fugue-plan.json"
          --runtime-sha "$FUGUE_RUNTIME_SHA"
          --github-output "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fugue-plan
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/fugue-plan.json
          if-no-files-found: error

  validate:
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout trusted Fugue runtime
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: _fugue
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact candidate head
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.head_sha }}
          path: _candidate
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: _fugue/package-lock.json
      - working-directory: _fugue
        run: npm ci
      - working-directory: _fugue
        run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fugue-plan
          path: _plan
      - name: Run protected-base validation commands against exact head
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ""
          GH_TOKEN: ""
        run: >-
          node _fugue/dist/cli.js integration-runtime validate
          --plan _plan/fugue-plan.json
          --cwd _candidate
          --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/fugue-validation.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fugue-validation
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/fugue-validation.json
          if-no-files-found: error

  finalize:
    if: always() && needs.prepare.result == 'success'
    needs: [prepare, validate]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # SECURITY INVARIANT (external): configure the restrictive default-branch-only deployment
    # policy before installing the Authority App key. The in-job audit is drift detection only.
    environment: fugue-authority
    permissions:
      actions: write
      checks: read
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      statuses: write
    steps:
      - name: Audit external Fugue Authority environment invariant
        env:
          FUGUE_PROTECTED_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          const [owner, repo] = process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY.split('/');
          const branch = process.env.FUGUE_PROTECTED_BRANCH;
          if (!branch) throw new Error('Repository default branch is unavailable.');
          const headers = {
            Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
            Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN}`,
            'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
          };
          const base = `https://api.github.com/repos/${owner}/${repo}/environments/fugue-authority`;
          const environmentResponse = await fetch(base, { headers });
          if (!environmentResponse.ok) {
            throw new Error(`fugue-authority environment is unavailable (${environmentResponse.status}); authority remains fail-closed.`);
          }
          const environment = await environmentResponse.json();
          const deployment = environment.deployment_branch_policy;
          if (!deployment || deployment.protected_branches !== false || deployment.custom_branch_policies !== true) {
            throw new Error('fugue-authority must use an explicit custom deployment branch policy.');
          }
          const policiesResponse = await fetch(`${base}/deployment-branch-policies?per_page=100`, { headers });
          if (!policiesResponse.ok) throw new Error(`Unable to verify fugue-authority branch policy (${policiesResponse.status}).`);
          const policies = await policiesResponse.json();
          const names = (policies.branch_policies ?? []).map((policy) => policy.name).sort();
          if (names.length !== 1 || names[0] !== branch) {
            throw new Error(`fugue-authority must allow exactly protected branch ${branch}; found ${names.join(', ') || 'none'}.`);
          }
          NODE
      - name: Mint narrow Fugue Authority token
        id: fugue-authority
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v3
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.FUGUE_AUTHORITY_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.FUGUE_AUTHORITY_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-variables: write
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fugue-plan
          path: _plan
      - if: needs.validate.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fugue-validation
          path: _validation
      - name: Finalize successful Integration
        if: needs.validate.result == 'success'
        env:
          FUGUE_AUTHORITY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.fugue-authority.outputs.token }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: >-
          node dist/cli.js integration-runtime finalize
          --plan _plan/fugue-plan.json
          --validation-result success
          --validation _validation/fugue-validation.json
      - name: Publish failed candidate validation
        if: needs.validate.result != 'success'
        env:
          FUGUE_VALIDATION_RESULT: ${{ needs.validate.result }}
          FUGUE_AUTHORITY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.fugue-authority.outputs.token }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: >-
          node dist/cli.js integration-runtime finalize
          --plan _plan/fugue-plan.json
          --validation-result "$FUGUE_VALIDATION_RESULT"
      - name: Refresh durable Fugue state comment
        if: always()
        env:
          FUGUE_PR: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          FUGUE_AUTHORITY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.fugue-authority.outputs.token }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node dist/cli.js reconcile --pr "$FUGUE_PR"
